rationale: Price at $11.16 remains above session VWAP ($11.09) and in the upper quartile of today's range (73.9%), so the frozen dip-absorption thesis is intact and the $11.08 invalidation has not been approached. Momentum is stalling (below 9-EMA at $11.20, flat low-volume 1m candles) but that is low-volume consolidation rather than a breakdown, and the 9 bps spread shows no exit pressure. Flipping short is unwarranted against VWAP support and a gap-down recovery structure, so I hold with the existing invalidation and take-profit.
